description: Implementation of the projects for the promotion in the fields of Drama, Performing Arts and Literature
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Although there are 09 sub panels representing 09 subject areas operate under the Arts Council of Sri Lanka, due to the lack of adequate funds, the activities of those sub panels are mostly limited to the national level and to the capital city. Also, the drama, performing arts and literature sectors are currently in a crisis due to the decline in audience, the decline in new productions, lack of theatres and the competition with the social media. Therefore, a provision of Rs.50 million has been allocated in the 2026 annual budget to implement appropriate projects with the objectives of revitalization in the field of drama, performing arts and literature at national level as well as regional level, empowering regional artists and bequeathing cultural heritage to future generations. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to implement the projects as follows, using the said provisions:

Promoting the scopes represented by the 09 sub panels under the Arts Council of Sri Lanka at the regional level.


Conducting the State Drama Festival in a more diversified manner and implementing a programme to encourage new drama productions and performances.


Conducting multicultural art festivals based on multicultural centres.


Providing facilities to cinema clusters built around cultural centres.
